claims.text: AI Fairness 360 provides over 71 bias detection metrics, 9 bias mitigation algorithms, and a metric explanations facility in a Python package conforming to scikit-learn conventions.
Reweighing and optimized pre-processing algorithms improve statistical parity difference and disparate impact metrics across Adult, German Credit, and COMPAS datasets.
Applying the Reweighing pre-processor on the Adult dataset test partition reduces the statistical parity difference from -0.2021 to -0.0119.
Reject option classification substantially improves fairness metrics on the Adult dataset but causes a significant reduction in classification accuracy.

evidence.description: The initial AIF360 Python package implements techniques from 8 published papers... includes over 71 bias detection metrics, 9 bias mitigation algorithms, and a unique extensible metric explanations facility.
For all datasets, the Reweighing and Optimized pre-processing algorithms improve fairness in both metrics presented.
The metrics for the original and transformed testing data will show a significant reduction in statistical parity difference (-0.2021 to -0.0119 in this case).
The Reject option classification algorithm improves fairness quite a bit, but also suffers a significant reduction in accuracy.

methodologies.name: AI Fairness 360 (AIF360) Toolkit
methodologies.description: An extensible open-source Python library providing standard abstractions for datasets, fairness metrics, explainers, and pre-, in-, and post-processing bias mitigation algorithms.

limitations.text: It is mathematically impossible to satisfy all definitions of fairness at the same time.
The least improvement in fairness metrics was observed on the German Credit dataset, likely due to its small size of 1,000 records.
Reject option classification post-processing is brittle and causes significant reductions in accuracy.
The current web service backend is limited to three built-in datasets and logistic regression classifiers.
The toolkit's metrics and algorithms focus primarily on distributive justice and do not capture all aspects or full scope of fairness.

future_work.text: Expand the toolkit to measure and mitigate other aspects of justice such as compensatory justice.
Extend the variety of types of explanations offered and create guidance for practitioners on when specific explanation types are most appropriate.
Expand the web application service to support user dataset uploads and additional classifier models.
